| [BulkSelection.tsx](BulkSelection.tsx.md) | current | The UI for bulk selection on list pages: a select-all and delete bar, a selectable card wrapper and a row checkbox. The state and deletion logic live in `lib/bulkSelection`. |
| [CodeBlock.tsx](CodeBlock.tsx.md) | current | A small preformatted code block with monospace styling (and optional copy or language props). |
| [CreatedAt.tsx](CreatedAt.tsx.md) | current | An item's creation date and time, with its relative age on hover. |
| [ModelPicker.tsx](ModelPicker.tsx.md) | current | A searchable model picker built from the model catalog. It shows each model's capabilities and context window, and whether it fits the job. |
| [PageHeader.tsx](PageHeader.tsx.md) | current | The one page heading used across the control plane: eyebrow, title, lede and a right-aligned action slot. It matches the header that the hand-written pages render inline. |
| [ReachabilityBadge.tsx](ReachabilityBadge.tsx.md) | current | Status badges for whether a server is reachable and how healthy it is. |
| [ResizeHandle.tsx](ResizeHandle.tsx.md) | current | Drag-to-resize for side panels: the nav rail, the settings and config drawers, the refine conversation and sheets. |
| [SectionCard.tsx](SectionCard.tsx.md) | current | The card that every remote-server section sits in: an icon and title header, then a body. Also a `StatCard`. |
| [SortSelect.tsx](SortSelect.tsx.md) | current | The sort control every list page uses, built on the themed Select rather than a native select (whose option list is drawn by the operating system and ignores the theme). |
